title: Build package projection and drift mechanics
description:
"Generic renderer, preset-projection, and drift-check APIs can materialize manifest-declared targets and compare regenerated output without owning or changing the production dogfood payload or live consumers.

## Background

This task proves reusable projection mechanics against synthetic fixtures. Production package content and live-consumer migration are outside this task.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Synthetic fixture packages prove exact file projection, managed-region preservation, executable modes, temporary-tree byte comparison, stale/extra/missing target findings, and deterministic ordering.
- [hard] REQ-02: A synthetic preset fixture derives gate definitions/assets through the same package API and detects an independent-inventory mismatch.
- [hard] REQ-03: The leaf changes only projection mechanics and fixtures; it does not author production skills/prompts/standards/gates or rewrite `.agents`, scripts, `.jit/reference`, presets, examples, or adopter docs.

## Scope

**Blast radius:** generic renderer, drift, and preset-projection modules plus synthetic fixtures only. Production package content and live-consumer migration are outside this task.

**Green landing:** Synthetic packages prove the reusable mechanics while every production dogfood asset and live path remains byte-unchanged."
